stories.title: Mold to host Tour of Britain Women stage for first time
stories.summary: The 2026 Lloyds Tour of Britain Women will start its third stage in Mold on Friday 21 August, with riders heading to The Great Orme in Llandudno for the finish, British Cycling has announced. stories.title: More than 1,150 children take part in triathlon day at Mold Leisure Centre with Alistair Brownlee
stories.summary: More than 1,150 children from schools across North Wales took part in a triathlon event at Gwella’s Mold Leisure Centre on Tuesday, with Olympic champion Alistair Brownlee attending to meet pupils and present finisher medals. stories.title: Welsh Government consults on leaseholder protections under new building safety law
stories.summary: The Welsh Government is consulting on how to put into practice new laws designed to stop leaseholders in Wales being billed for building safety failures they did not cause.
